user.title: Stove Vision
user.description: Read the stove's zone displays from a camera pointed at it. Calibrate the zone positions in the options afterwards.

data_description.snapshot_url: URL returning a JPEG of the stove at full resolution, e.g. a go2rtc frame.jpeg endpoint
data_description.camera_entity: Alternative to the URL: a camera entity. With 'Read the camera's stream' on, frames come from its stream at full resolution
data_description.rotation: Turn the frame so the control panel is upright
data_description.camera_stream: With a camera: take one full-resolution frame from its stream (via ffmpeg) instead of its snapshot, which many cameras scale down. Falls back to the snapshot.

error.no_source: Set a snapshot URL or a camera.
error.cannot_fetch: Could not fetch a frame from the source.
error.invalid_rings: Use cx,cy,rx,ry per ring, two rings separated by ;

init.title: Stove Vision
init.description: Positions are pixels in the rotated frame. Zone positions are the centre (x,y) of each zone's digit, see the Panel image. Rings are the printed circles around each zone, see the Zones image.
